li.label: a guest liked our room
li.description: A guest slept better here than anywhere else on the road, and made a point of telling me so.

li.label: a guest found fault
li.description: Where we put our guest to sleep wasn't good enough, and they told me all about it. Some of it was fair.

li.label: showed a guest around
li.description: I walked a guest round the colony, pens and workshops and all. They had a question for every corner.

li.label: a guest's stories of home
li.description: All through supper, a guest talked about home. I think I could find my way round the place now.

li.label: sat up with a guest
li.description: Our guest couldn't settle in a strange bed, so I kept them company until the small hours.

li.label: a guest lent a hand
li.description: Our guest wouldn't be waited on. They worked beside me all afternoon like one of us.

li.label: a good haggle
li.description: A guest and I haggled over a price long after either of us cared what it came to.

li.label: a guest's thanks
li.description: Before leaving, a guest came looking for me to say thank you for the stay.

li.label: our guest is staying
li.description: The council said yes. Our guest won't be leaving with the others after all.

li.label: maybe another season
li.description: I walked our guest out as far as the fields. Another season, the council said. I'll believe it when I see them on the road.

li.label: welcome another time
li.description: Not this time, they said, but I'd be welcome another season. One of them walked me out past the fields.

li.label: they wouldn't have me
li.description: I asked to stay, and they said no. I didn't go to supper after that.

li.label: my complaint was heard
li.description: They heard out every complaint I had about my stay. By the end I'd half forgotten what I was angry about.

li.label: brushed off
li.description: I told them what was wrong with my stay. All I got back was talk.

li.label: imperial manners
li.description: A visitor from the Empire showed me how things are done at court. I bowed wrong three times.

li.label: news from court
li.description: There's a new duke at the Empire's court, a visitor told me, and an old one sent off to a moon. I lost track of the names halfway through.

li.label: talk of the senate
li.description: A visitor explained how their republic governs itself. Our council looks simple next to it.

li.label: a mason's tricks
li.description: Talked stone and mortar with a visitor from the republic until dark. I want to try building their way.

li.label: a settler's tall tales
li.description: A settler told me stories from their country, and every one grew in the telling. I didn't want them to stop.

li.label: learned a rancher's trick
li.description: A settler showed me how their ranchers handle animals. I've been practicing on anything with four legs.

li.label: named in the dispatches
li.description: Our colony is in the Empire's dispatches, listed between a mining town and a monastery. Paid in full.

li.label: we handed over a deserter
li.description: That soldier came to us with empty hands, and we handed them over for the reward. They didn't even fight when the patrol came.

li.label: a visitor liked what we make
li.description: A traveler tasted what we make here and held out a hand for more.

li.label: an evening by the hearth
li.description: A traveler and I sat at the hearth and watched the logs settle. We didn't need to say much.

li.label: shared our books
li.description: It's rare to meet anyone who reads. This visitor did, and sat with me over our books all afternoon, comparing letters.

li.label: talked tactics
li.description: We went over how a mage and a fighter work together. I know where to stand next time.

li.label: compared workings
li.description: Another mage and I compared how our schools do things. We disagreed about nearly all of it. I'd do it again tomorrow.

li.label: compared forms
li.description: Went through our fighting forms together, slowly. I picked something up.

li.label: a healer's hands
li.description: A healer eased an old ache of mine with a touch. It's still gone.

li.label: a traveling mage's working
li.description: A traveler with the gift did a working just for me. I've gone over it in my head all day.

li.label: met a mage of another school
li.description: A traveling mage and I traded workings until late. Theirs come at everything from the wrong side, and they still work.

li.label: talked with a wandering fighter
li.description: A traveler who fights for a living showed me a few things about footwork.

li.label: a strange creature up close
li.description: Saw one of the strange animals of these parts up close today. I'd only ever heard them described.

li.label: watched a great bird
li.description: I got a good look at one of those huge running birds. Its feathers are longer than my arm.

li.label: eyes in the dark
li.description: A pair of eyes watched me cross the yard after dark. Only an animal, but I walked the rest of the way faster.

li.label: saw a gallatross
li.description: A gallatross walked past the colony. I didn't know anything alive could be that big.

li.label: this strange land
li.description: Everything out here grows to the wrong size. I stopped to stare three times today.

li.label: the trees were watching
li.description: The eyes in the trees turned to look at me. I didn't stay.

li.label: a guest room worth the name
li.description: Our guest room is fit for a guest at last. I'd sleep in it myself.
